description: Na₂MgGe₂(SbO₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.85 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.74 Å. Mg is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-56°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.80 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-52°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.82 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.37 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.05 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ONaMgSb₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂GeSb tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Ge atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom.
